scope.audience: Visitors learning what the 6529 Network Museum is
scope.primary_task: Understand what the Museum holds, how it works, and where to go next
scope.release_intent: Give the Collection care section the same top divider as its sibling sections, and use one label, Explore the Collection, for the page's links to the Collection

not_applicable.J08: The route's interaction is plain links; there are no disclosures, galleries, or forms
not_applicable.J09: Only the populated publication state is in scope; the shared publication-unavailable state is unchanged
not_applicable.J11: Layout and copy only; no data-loading or rendering path changed
not_applicable.J12: Museum routes render en-US by design; every Museum string comes from the en-US Museum messages
not_applicable.J13: No wallet or chain interaction on this surface

decisions: The LCL:3001 badge in the header marks a locally served build; production 6529.io does not show it. The 390x844 cell uses a Pixel 7 phone profile, so the app shows its mobile-app banner and touch header as it does for phone visitors.
